def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0]/A + p[1]*t**2/A + p[2] + p[3]*A + p[4]*A**2
            + p[5]*np.sin(A) + p[6]*np.cos(A) + p[7]*np.sin(2*A) + p[8]*np.cos(2*A) + p[9]*np.cos(3*A))
